name: gmail-mcp
description: MCP server connecting Claude Desktop to Gmail via OAuth — search, read, send, reply, manage labels, drafts, and attachments.
instructions: Install with pip install -e .; place credentials.json in your OS config directory (see README.md); authenticate with python -c "from gmail_mcp.auth import get_gmail_service; get_gmail_service()"; configure your MCP client to launch the installed environment's Python with arguments -m gmail_mcp.
